newsitem.title: UK: UK awards simulator contract to Lockheed.
newsitem.headline: UK awards simulator contract to Lockheed.

text.p: The British Government said it has awarded an 180 million stg contract to Lockheed Martin Corp to supply two new simulation systems for Army training in the UK and Germany.
The Ministry of Defence said in a statement the Combined Arms Tactical Trainer (CATT) will create a synthetic combat environment which will enable realistic battlegroup-level training.
The CATT systems will also significantly benefit the environment, allowing the Army to reduce its traditional dependence on field training.
GEC Marconi GEC.L has been selected by Lockheed-Martin as its lead UK partner. It is planned that the British company will take over as prime contractor from 2003.

The award of the CATT contract will intitially sustain or create about 90 jobs mainly at GEC Marconi at Donnibristle, Fife. Further jobs will be created in the UK when CATT enters its production phase. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717.
